item.redcyber.redstone_alloy_ingot.desc: Base metal for cybernetic implants: iron fused with redstone.
item.redcyber.redstone_circuit.desc: Logic board that routes redstone signals through the body.
item.redcyber.redstone_servo.desc: Muscle replacement: converts redstone charge into force.
item.redcyber.neural_chip.desc: Translates nerve impulses into redstone pulses and back.
item.redcyber.power_cell.desc: Compressed redstone core. Powers a single implant.
item.redcyber.cyber_eye.desc: A redstone lens replaces the eyeball: sees in the dark and reads distant details.
item.redcyber.cyber_arm.desc: Servo-driven arm with an alloy frame. Hits harder and mines faster.
item.redcyber.cyber_legs.desc: Piston legs that push the body forward far faster than flesh can.
item.redcyber.cyber_heart.desc: A redstone pump that never tires and slowly repairs nearby tissue.
item.redcyber.cyber_lungs.desc: Filter lungs that pull oxygen straight out of water.
item.redcyber.cyber_spine.effect: No fall damage, high knockback resistance
item.redcyber.cyber_spine.desc: Alloy spine with shock absorbers: the body simply refuses to break on impact.
